title: 第286章  我不喜欢跟手下败将打第二次
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
赵守道摔落在擂台外的青石地面上，碎石飞溅，灰尘扬起，将他那件洗得发白的灰色长袍沾满了碎屑和尘土。他挣扎着想要撑起身体，左臂的衣袍已经被纯阳之火灼烧出一片焦黑，露出下面泛红的皮肉，灵力在经脉中紊乱地冲撞，如同被搅浑的池水，短时间内根本无法重新凝聚。
但他毕竟是化神三层。那股紊乱在几息之间便被强行压制下去，赵守道撑着地面缓缓站起身，灰色长袍上还沾着碎石和焦痕，面容却已经恢复了那种平淡如水的神色。他低着头，看着自己微微发颤的指尖，沉默了很长一段时间，然后抬起头，目光穿过广场上攒动的人群，落在那道依旧站在擂台边缘的青色身影上。
“时间到了。”赵守道开口，声音恢复了那种一贯的平淡，却带着一股极其克制的冷意，“但我还没输。”
他向前迈了一步，化神三层的威压如同被重新点燃的火炉，在他周身缓缓升腾而起。擂台上那些碎裂的阵纹在他脚下发出细微的嗡鸣，仿佛被一股无形的力量牵引，正试图重新凝聚成形。他的目光死死锁在李寒山身上，声音不高，却清晰地压过了广场上嘈杂的议论声：“李寒山，方才是擂台比试，我确实在一炷香的时限内没能拿下你。但比试归比试，胜负归胜负。你那一剑确实出乎意料，但若放开手脚再打一场，我不会再给你第二次机会。”
他的语气平淡如初，但那股被极力压制的怒意却从每一个字中渗透出来，让广场上那些原本还在议论的弟子们不约而同地安静了下来。化神三层被元婴巅峰正面打落擂台，这种事放在整个中洲修仙界都是闻所未闻的笑话。赵守道修炼了一千二百年，从未受过这等屈辱。
王昊靠在石柱上，目光在赵守道和李寒山之间来回扫了一圈，语气带着一种看好戏的兴致：“赵师兄这是下不来台了。被元婴修士当众打落擂台，换谁都咽不下这口气。”
“咽不下又如何？”玄阴子的声音从旁边传来，带着那种特有的慵懒嘲弄，“刚才那一剑里明显藏着神魂层面的力量，这李寒山，有点东西。”他目光微微眯起，像是想透过李寒山的皮囊看清他识海深处的情况，“有意思，真有意思。”
擂台上，李寒山将火焰长剑缓缓散去。他能感觉到识海中那枚重阳元胎的光芒比方才黯淡了几分，显然是刚才那七成魂力释放的后遗症，但那股力量带来的反馈让他心中有了底。重阳元胎的威能远超他之前的预期，虽然消耗不小，但若是与赵守道真正放手一战，他未必会输。
就算赵守道祭出元神，他的重阳元胎同样可以祭出来。虽然元胎尚未彻底成形，但作为元神雏形，已经具备初步的对抗能力。只要不过度消耗，撑过对方元神的正面冲击并非不可能。
就在这时，一道银白色的剑光如同破开夜空的闪电，精准地落在李寒山身前。夜霜华的身影出现在剑光中，惊鸿剑已经出鞘三寸，剑意如同一道无形的屏障，将赵守道那股正在扩散的威压隔绝在外。
她站在李寒山面前，目光直视着赵守道，声音清冷而带着一股不容置疑的力度：“赵师兄，擂台比试的规则很清楚。一炷香时限已到，李寒山没有被你击败，按照规则，他已经通过了阻击，直接晋级决赛。你若再动手，便违反宗门规矩了。”
赵守道的脚步顿了一下。他看了一眼夜霜华手中那柄已经出鞘三寸的惊鸿剑，又看了一眼她身后那道正在缓步走来的身影。夜霜华的修为比他低了一个小境界，但他心中清楚，惊鸿剑的名头在合欢宗意味着什么。若真撕破脸动手，夜霜华一剑斩出来的后果，他未必承受得起。
但他没有退步。“夜师妹，我并非要违反规矩。”赵守道的声音平静，却带着一股不容退让的笃定，“我只是觉得，方才那一剑来得太过突然，我还没有真正接住。我要向他发起挑战，不是擂台比试，是私下切磋。生死不论，各安天命。”
此言一出，广场上再次响起一片倒吸冷气的声音。“生死不论……赵师兄这是动真格的了！”“化神三层对元婴巅峰提出生死不论的挑战，这跟谋杀有什么区别？”“李师兄不可能接吧？刚才那一剑虽然有奇效，但生死相搏跟擂台比试完全不是一回事。”
李寒山站在夜霜华身后，将那些议论声听在耳中。他没有急着回答，而是感知着识海中那枚正在缓缓恢复光芒的重阳元胎。刚才那一剑让他清晰认识到了元胎的真正威力，虽然消耗了七成的魂力，但只要给他时间恢复，再战一场并非没有胜算。
但他心中同时也在权衡另一件事——夜霜华方才说过，他还有一场比试要打。如果他现在应下赵守道的挑战，就算赢了，也必定会消耗大量魂力和灵力。到那时再面对决赛的对手，状态不可能恢复到巅峰。他未必能稳赢。
夜霜华显然也想到了这一点。她侧过头，目光落在李寒山身上，带着一丝他自己能读懂的关切。她没有开口，但那眼神分明在说：别上当。
李寒山收回目光，沉默了两息，然后朝赵守道微微摇了摇头。他的声音不大，却带着一种从容到让人牙痒的平静：“赵师兄，我没有兴趣跟手下败将打第二次。”
赵守道的脸色终于变了。他那张平淡如水的面容上第一次浮现出明显的怒意，灰白色的灵力在他周身暴涨了一瞬，脚下的石板裂开数道纹路，连他身旁那些碎裂的阵纹都在那股灵力冲击下泛起细密的涟漪。他咬着牙，一字一顿地说：“李寒山，你说什么？”
“我说，”李寒山站在擂台上，居高临下地看着他，“我不喜欢跟手下败将打第二次。”

赵守道的胸膛剧烈起伏了几下，化神三层的威压如同被点燃的火山，在他周身翻涌不息。他想要冲上擂台，却被夜霜华那道银白色的剑光挡在了半步之外。两人对峙了片刻，赵守道的目光从李寒山身上移开，落在夜霜华脸上，又扫过高台方向那些正在观望的长老们，最终化作一声压抑到极点的冷哼。
他猛地转身，大步朝广场外走去，灰色长袍的背影在暮色中显得格外孤厉。陈杰站在高台边缘，看着赵守道离去的方向，脸色阴沉得如同暴风雨前的天空，却没有追上去。他转头看了一眼擂台方向那道正在缓缓走下擂台的青色身影，手指在袖中攥得青筋暴起，最终也转身离去，步伐带着一种极力压制却依旧泄露了痕迹的仓皇。
高台上，九长老的目光终于真正落在了李寒山身上。他那双如电的眼眸带着审视，又带着一种更深的意味，在李寒山身上停留了许久，仿佛在重新评估这个被他忽视了许久的北荒弟子。但他没有开口，也没有任何表示，只是在片刻后微微眯了一下眼，便移开了目光。
而在高台另一侧，五长老依旧端坐在那里。她的目光落在李寒山身上时，嘴角浮现出一丝极淡的笑意，如同一潭深不见底的秋水在表面漾开一圈极浅的涟漪。
李寒山走下擂台时，夜色已经悄然降临。广场上的人群正在陆续散去，但那些目光依旧落在他身上，带着惊叹、好奇、敬畏，还有几分不确定的审视。他在石阶边缘站定，抬头望向天际那一抹正在缓缓黯淡的暮色，心中那份因重阳元胎带来的笃定如同落地的种子，正在缓慢而坚定地扎根，生长。
他赢了。元婴巅峰，打赢了化神三层。虽然那一剑有取巧的成分，虽然赵守道确实轻敌了，但结果摆在那里。从今以后，合欢宗上下，再也没有人敢用“北荒来的老登”来称呼他。
content_en:
Zhao Shoudao fell to the bluestone ground outside the ring. The gravel flew and dust rose, covering his white washed gray robe with debris and dust. He struggled to hold himself up. The robe on his left arm had been burnt black by the pure Yang fire, exposing the reddish skin underneath. The spiritual power was chaotically colliding in the meridians, like water in a muddy pool, and could not be condensed again in a short time.
But he is at the third level of God Transformation after all. The chaos was forcibly suppressed in a few breaths. Zhao Shoudao stood up slowly, holding on to the ground. His gray robe was still stained with gravel and scorch marks, but his face had returned to that calm expression. He lowered his head and looked at his slightly trembling fingertips. He was silent for a long time, then raised his head and looked through the crowd in the square, landing on the cyan figure still standing at the edge of the ring.
"The time has come." Zhao Shoudao said, his voice returned to its usual calmness, but with an extremely restrained coldness, "But I haven't lost yet."
He took a step forward, and the pressure of the third level of divine transformation slowly rose around him like a rekindled furnace. The broken formations on the arena hummed slightly beneath his feet, as if they were being pulled by an invisible force and were trying to condense into shape again. His eyes were fixed on Li Hanshan, and his voice was low, but he could clearly override the noisy discussion in the square: "Li Hanshan, this is the competition in the ring, and I really couldn't defeat you within the time limit of one stick of incense. But the competition is a competition, and the victory is the victory. Your sword was indeed unexpected, but if you let go and fight again, I will not give you a second chance."
His tone was as calm as ever, but the suppressed anger seeped out of every word, causing the disciples who were still discussing in the square to fall silent in unison. The third level of the God Transformation was knocked off the stage by the Nascent Soul Peak. This kind of thing is an unheard joke in the entire Central Continent cultivation world. Zhao Shoudao has been practicing for twelve hundred years and has never suffered such humiliation.
Wang Hao leaned on the stone pillar, his eyes swept back and forth between Zhao Shoudao and Li Hanshan, and his tone was as if he was watching a good show: "Senior Brother Zhao can't get off the stage anymore. Being knocked off the stage by Yuanying monk in front of everyone, no one can swallow this breath."
"So what if you can't swallow it?" Xuanyinzi's voice came from the side, with that unique lazy mockery, "The sword just now clearly contained the power of the soul level. There is something about this Li Hanshan." He narrowed his eyes slightly, as if he wanted to see through Li Hanshan's skin to see clearly what was going on in the depths of his sea of consciousness, "Interesting, really interesting."
On the ring, Li Hanshan slowly dispersed the flaming sword. He could feel that the light of the Chongyang Yuan Fei in the sea of ​​​​consciousness was a bit dimmer than before. It was obviously the sequelae of the release of 70% of the soul power just now, but the feedback brought by that power gave him peace of mind. The power of Chongyang Yuantai far exceeded his previous expectations. Although it consumed a lot of money, he might not lose if he had a real free fight with Zhao Shoudao.
Even if Zhao Shoudao sacrifices his soul, his Chongyang Yuan Fei can also be sacrificed. Although the Yuan Fei has not yet been completely formed, as the prototype of the Yuan Shen, it already has preliminary resistance capabilities. As long as you don't consume too much, it's not impossible to withstand the frontal impact of the opponent's soul.
At this moment, a silver-white sword light fell accurately in front of Li Hanshan like lightning breaking through the night sky. Ye Shuanghua's figure appeared in the sword light, and the Jinghong Sword had been unsheathed three inches. The sword's intention was like an invisible barrier, isolating Zhao Shoudao's spreading coercion.
She stood in front of Li Hanshan, looking directly at Zhao Shoudao, and her voice was cold and unquestionable: "Brother Zhao, the rules of the arena competition are very clear. The time limit for one stick of incense has expired, and Li Hanshan has not been defeated by you. According to the rules, he has passed the block and advanced directly to the finals. If you do it again, you will violate the sect.Behave yourself. "
Zhao Shoudao paused for a moment. He glanced at the Jinghong Sword in Ye Shuanghua's hand, which was already three inches out of its sheath, and then at the figure walking slowly behind her. Ye Shuanghua's cultivation level was a little lower than him, but he knew in his heart what the name of Jinghong Sword meant in Hehuan Sect. If he really breaks out and takes action, he may not be able to bear the consequences of Ye Shuanghua's sword.
But he didn't back down. "Junior sister Ye, I don't mean to break the rules. "Zhao Shoudao's voice was calm, but with a determination that would not give in. "I just feel that the sword just came too suddenly, and I haven't really caught it yet. I want to challenge him, not to compete in the ring, but to discuss in private. Regardless of life or death, everyone has his or her destiny. "
As soon as this was said, there was another gasp of air in the square. "No matter life or death...Senior Brother Zhao is serious! "The third level of transformation poses a life-or-death challenge to the peak of Nascent Soul. What is the difference between this and murder?" "It's impossible for Senior Brother Li to pick up, right?" Although the sword strike just now had miraculous effects, a life-and-death fight was completely different from a competition in the ring. "
Li Hanshan stood behind Ye Shuanghua and listened to the comments. He did not answer in a hurry, but felt the Chongyang Yuan Fei in the sea of ​​consciousness that was slowly regaining its light. The sword strike just now made him clearly realize the true power of Yuan Fei. Although it consumed 70% of his soul power, as long as he was given time to recover, he would have a chance of winning in another battle.
But he was also weighing another thing in his mind - Ye Shuanghua just said that he still had a competition to fight. If he accepts Zhao Shoudao's challenge now, even if he wins, he will definitely consume a lot of soul and spiritual power. Facing the opponents in the finals by then, it is impossible to return to the peak of form. He may not be sure to win.
Ye Shuanghua obviously thought of this too. She turned her head and her eyes fell on Li Hanshan, with a trace of concern that he could understand. She didn't speak, but her eyes clearly said: Don't be fooled.
Li Hanshan withdrew his gaze, remained silent for two breaths, and then shook his head slightly towards Zhao Shoudao. His voice was not loud, but it carried a calmness that made people feel uncomfortable: "Senior Brother Zhao, I have no interest in fighting my defeated general a second time. "
Zhao Shoudao's expression finally changed. For the first time, obvious anger appeared on his plain face. Gray-white spiritual power surged around him for a moment. The stone slab under his feet cracked several lines, and even the broken formations around him showed fine ripples under the impact of the spiritual power. He gritted his teeth and said word by word: "Li Hanshan, what did you say? "
"I said," Li Hanshan stood on the ring and looked at him condescendingly, "I don't like fighting a defeated opponent a second time. "
Zhao Shoudao's chest rose and fell violently several times, and the pressure from the third level of transformation surged around him like a ignited volcano. He wanted to rush onto the ring, but was blocked by Ye Shuanghua's silver sword light. The two faced off for a moment. Zhao Shoudao's eyes moved away from Li Hanshan and landed on Ye Shuanghua's face. He then glanced at the elders who were watching in the direction of the high platform, and finally turned into an extremely suppressed cold snort.
He turned around suddenly and strode out of the square. His back in the gray robe looked particularly lonely in the dusk. Chen Jie stood on the edge of the high platform, looking at the direction Zhao Shoudao was leaving, his face as gloomy as the sky before the storm, but he did not pursue him. He turned his head and glanced at the cyan figure who was slowly walking down the ring in the direction of the ring. His fingers were clenched in his sleeves until the veins bulged. Finally, he turned and left, with a hasty pace that he tried to suppress but still revealed traces of.
On the high platform, the Ninth Elder's eyes finally fell on Li Hanshan. His electric eyes, with scrutiny and a deeper meaning, stayed on Li Hanshan for a long time, as if he was re-evaluating this Beihuang disciple who had been ignored by him for a long time.But he didn't speak or express anything. He just narrowed his eyes slightly after a moment and then looked away.
On the other side of the high platform, the fifth elder was still sitting there. When her eyes fell on Li Hanshan, a faint smile appeared on the corner of her mouth, like a bottomless pool of autumn water creating a circle of very shallow ripples on the surface.
When Li Hanshan walked off the ring, night had quietly fallen. The crowd in the square was gradually dispersing, but those eyes still fell on him, with wonder, curiosity, awe, and a somewhat uncertain look. He stood at the edge of the stone steps and looked up at the slowly dimming twilight in the sky. The certainty brought by the Double Ninth Yuan Fei in his heart was like a seed that fell to the ground, slowly but firmly taking root and growing.
He won. At the peak of Nascent Soul, he defeated the third level of God Transformation. Although the sword was tricky, and although Zhao Shoudao did underestimate the enemy, the result was there. From now on, no one in the Hehuan Sect would dare to call him "Lao Deng from Beihuang".
